evidence_type: direct_user_confirmation; not arrival measurement or manufacturer qualification

user_confirmed_selection.note: 型号、KV和极对数是已确认项目输入；后续相关工作先读唯一记录，不重复询问型号。

user_image_reuse_check_2026_10_15.interpretation: 复用既有用户规格图；本次未引入新型号或新规格参数。

motor.selection_status: 用户已确认选型；不是候选或待用户确认
motor.drive_arrangement: one FOC main board per motor; same board design; plug-in G431 core module retained
motor.runtime_note: 1 s is a sizing screen, not a mandated operational cutoff or demonstrated board capability

seller_image_evidence.current_definition: unknown: measurement point, bus/phase, RMS/peak, continuous/peak rating and duration not specified

unresolved: 80 A measurement point, bus/phase and RMS/peak/continuous/peak-duration definition
phase current and any rated/continuous/peak current specification
motor-specific torque value and the printed N/m unit/measurement conditions

hall.budget_interpretation: 50 mA per motor complete five-wire Hall assembly; not 50 mA per bare sensing IC
hall.signal_note: Hall U/V/W are logic signals, distinct from power-phase PH_U/PH_V/PH_W
unresolved: physical Pin 1 and mating-face versus wire-exit viewing orientation
H-JSY housing/latch/mating dimensions; 2.0 mm pitch alone does not prove JST PH compatibility
output high/low voltage range, edge timing and MCU power-off injection
electrical phase offset and measured forward/reverse Hall state sequence

buck5V_budget_mA.qualification: allocation only; current limit does not guarantee continuous load, startup or thermal performance

other_user_constraints.minimum_working_ambient: 0 degrees C and above (user wording: 0°C以上)
other_user_constraints.external_BUS_capacitors: permitted immediately beside busbars; no current volume limit
other_user_constraints.PCB: one FOC main board with plug-in G431 module
other_user_constraints.CAN: required on every project board; FOC main board retains CAN
other_user_constraints.regenerative_braking: required; local current/voltage protection and source absorption capability remain design constraints

working_ambient_screen_C.meaning: ambient temperature, not case or junction temperature; component self-heating and cooling remain to be verified
